title: Sing to the Great Jehovah's Praise

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Sing to the great Jehovah's praise!
Who kindly lengthens out our days,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: His providence hath brought us through
We all, with vows and anthems new,

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: O God, Thy mercies past we own,
To Thee presenting through Thy Son
What e'er we have and are,
What e'er we have and are.
